result.brief: LeWAM 提出端到端 JEPA 框架，联合训练下一潜状态预测与动作流匹配，并对潜状态施加各向同性高斯约束，使单一模型兼具策略执行与基于潜动力学的规划能力，学习到控制相关的表征。
result.reason: End-to-end JEPA latent world model with action-conditioned dynamics and control-relevant representations; contributes to visual representation learning and world modeling, though applied to robot control.
